nodes.name: Mini-Program Pages
nodes.responsibility: WeChat mini-program page layer: post list, post detail, create post, user profile, message list, chat room, category browser. Orchestrates components and API/WS clients.

nodes.name: Mini-Program Components
nodes.responsibility: Reusable UI components: post card, comment item, message bubble, category tag, user avatar, loading skeleton.

nodes.name: Mini-Program API Client
nodes.responsibility: HTTP REST client wrapping wx.request with JWT token injection, error normalization, and response typing.

nodes.name: Mini-Program WebSocket Client
nodes.responsibility: WebSocket client wrapping wx.connectSocket with state machine, heartbeat, exponential backoff reconnection, and message ACK protocol.

nodes.name: Mini-Program Auth Module
nodes.responsibility: WeChat login flow: wx.login() → code exchange → JWT storage. Token refresh and session recovery.

nodes.name: Backend API Routes
nodes.responsibility: FastAPI route handlers for auth, users, posts, comments, categories, messages. Validates requests, delegates to services, returns responses. Stateless.

nodes.name: Backend WebSocket Handler
nodes.responsibility: WebSocket endpoint: accept connections, authenticate via token, manage session registry, route messages between users. Single endpoint multiplexed by message type.

nodes.name: Authentication Service
nodes.responsibility: WeChat code exchange with WeChat API, JWT token issuance and validation, user identity resolution. Trust boundary between WeChat and the application.

nodes.name: Post Service
nodes.responsibility: Post CRUD, pagination, full-text search, category filtering, view counting. Business rules: rate limiting per user, content length limits, soft-delete.

nodes.name: Comment Service
nodes.responsibility: Comment CRUD with self-referencing threading (parent_id), nested reply depth limit (max 2 levels). Soft-delete with cascade.

nodes.name: Message Service
nodes.responsibility: Direct message send/receive, conversation listing (grouped by other user), message status (sent/delivered/read), offline message queue, delivery confirmation via ACK.

nodes.name: Category Service
nodes.responsibility: Category listing, creation (admin only), post count tracking per category. Read-heavy, minimal writes.

nodes.name: User Repository
nodes.responsibility: User data access: find by WeChat openid, create on first login, update profile. Encapsulates SQLAlchemy queries for User model.

nodes.name: Post Repository
nodes.responsibility: Post data access: cursor-paginated listing, full-text search via PostgreSQL TSVECTOR, category filtering. Soft-delete support.

nodes.name: Comment Repository
nodes.responsibility: Comment data access: find by post_id with eager-loaded user and nested replies. Tree-building logic for threaded display.

nodes.name: Message Repository
nodes.responsibility: Message data access: conversation history between two users, unread count per conversation, offline message retrieval, status updates (delivered/read).

nodes.name: Category Repository
nodes.responsibility: Category data access: list all, find by id, create, update post count. Read-optimized with in-memory caching consideration.

nodes.name: Database Models
nodes.responsibility: SQLAlchemy ORM entity definitions: User, Post, Comment, Category, Message, Conversation. Schema relationships, constraints, indexes.

nodes.name: Backend Core Infrastructure
nodes.responsibility: Database session management (async), application factory, configuration (Pydantic Settings), CORS middleware, exception handlers, structured logging.

nodes.name: WebSocket Session Manager
nodes.responsibility: Track online users: user_id → WebSocket connection mapping. Handle connect/disconnect lifecycle. Broadcast online status changes. Shared mutable state with explicit lock.

nodes.name: WeChat External API
nodes.responsibility: External WeChat server API: code2session (login code exchange), access token management. External trust boundary — not owned by this project.

nodes.name: Pydantic Schemas
nodes.responsibility: Pydantic v2 request/response models for all API endpoints. Input validation, serialization, OpenAPI documentation generation.

boundary_conditions.description: WeChat login code exchange may fail — WeChat API returns error (invalid code, rate limit, system busy)
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: WeChat code2session returns errcode != 0. Service returns structured error, frontend shows retry prompt. Rate-limited codes get 429 with Retry-After.

boundary_conditions.description: JWT token may be expired, malformed, or revoked on every authenticated request
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Auth middleware returns 401 with error code. Frontend API client catches 401, attempts token refresh or redirects to login. WebSocket connection drops on expired token.

boundary_conditions.description: WebSocket connection interrupted by network change, app background, or server disconnect
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Client state machine triggers reconnection with exponential backoff (1s→2s→4s→8s, max 5 retries). Server session manager cleans up stale connections after heartbeat timeout (90s). Offline messages queued for delivery on reconnect.

boundary_conditions.description: Concurrent comment/post creation may cause race conditions on counters or tree structures
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: PostgreSQL atomic increments for view/reply counts. Comments use database-level ordering (created_at) with id tiebreaker. Optimistic concurrency for nested reply depth checks.

boundary_conditions.description: Message delivery to offline recipient — must persist and deliver on reconnect
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: If session manager reports user offline, message is persisted with status='sent'. On recipient WebSocket connect, query undelivered messages and push via WS. Recipient sends ACK, status updated to 'delivered' then 'read'.

boundary_conditions.description: User-generated content may contain spam, abuse, or prohibited material
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Content length limits enforced at Pydantic schema layer. Basic sensitive word list checked server-side before persistence. Flagged posts go to 'review' status (visible only to author). Admin moderation endpoints for approve/reject.

boundary_conditions.description: WeChat mini-program bundle size limit (2MB main package, 12MB subpackages total)
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Use WeChat subpackage loading: chat module as independent subpackage. Images loaded from remote CDN, not bundled. Tree-shaking via TypeScript compiler. Bundle size checked in CI.

boundary_conditions.description: Database connection pool exhaustion under concurrent request load
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: SQLAlchemy pool_size and max_overflow configured. Connection timeout with 503 response if pool exhausted. Health check endpoint monitors pool utilization.

notes: Monolith backend — all services in one process. Split along service boundaries if UNNC student scale (~10k) is exceeded.
WebSocket and HTTP share the same FastAPI process via ASGI. Uvicorn workers handle both protocols.
Frontend is WeChat native (not Uni-app) — already scaffolded. Uses Glass-Easel component framework and Skyline render engine.
ponytail: comment tree depth limited to 2 levels (flat + one nesting). Add closure table if full threading needed.
ponytail: sensitive word filter as simple list check. Add ML-based moderation if spam becomes a problem.

Intentional cycle: mp-api-client ↔ mp-auth. mp-auth calls login endpoint via mp-api-client during authentication bootstrap; mp-api-client reads JWT from mp-auth for request headers. Bootstrapping dependency — not a design defect. Break by having mp-auth use raw wx.request for the single login call if the cycle causes issues.
